g.text: UNFINISHED PCB CHECKPOINT - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. X = intentionally unconnected pin.

g.desc: UNFINISHED PCB CHECKPOINT - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. X = intentionally unconnected pin.

g.text: PC14 / PC15 sink current: active low | Blue indicates 5 V bus power

g.desc: PC14 / PC15 sink current: active low | Blue indicates 5 V bus power

g.text: POWER / COMPUTE + SENSORS / INTERFACES. Named boundaries connect between functional circuits.

g.desc: POWER / COMPUTE + SENSORS / INTERFACES. Named boundaries connect between functional circuits.

g.text: Rotorflight RDMS-NEXUS_F7 pin map; boundary labels connect the functional units

g.desc: Rotorflight RDMS-NEXUS_F7 pin map; boundary labels connect the functional units

g.text: W25N01GV 128 MB | /CS, /WP, /HOLD pull-ups | EP intentionally floating

g.desc: W25N01GV 128 MB | /CS, /WP, /HOLD pull-ups | EP intentionally floating

g.text: J1 connects the separate header board; VX / GND enter at pins 1 / 2

g.desc: J1 connects the separate header board; VX / GND enter at pins 1 / 2

g.text: USB 2.0 device | CC pull-downs: 5.1k | F1: VBUS resettable fuse

g.desc: USB 2.0 device | CC pull-downs: 5.1k | F1: VBUS resettable fuse

g.text: A: UART4 / CRSF | B: UART6 | C: UART3 | DSM: UART1

g.desc: A: UART4 / CRSF | B: UART6 | C: UART3 | DSM: UART1

g.text: Press BOOT during reset for DFU

g.desc: Press BOOT during reset for DFU

g.text: SPI1: inertial sensor | SPI2: blackbox | I2C1: barometer

g.desc: SPI1: inertial sensor | SPI2: blackbox | I2C1: barometer

g.text: ICM-42688-P; IMU_CS pull-up maintains SPI mode at startup; IMU_INT -> U1.50

g.desc: ICM-42688-P; IMU_CS pull-up maintains SPI mode at startup; IMU_INT -> U1.50

g.text: Local 3V3 bypass: C1-4 VDD, C5 bulk, C6-7 VDDA, C8 VBAT; C9 VCAP only

g.desc: Local 3V3 bypass: C1-4 VDD, C5 bulk, C6-7 VDDA, C8 VBAT; C9 VCAP only

g.text: 8 MHz HSE with load capacitors; BOOT0 button and pull-down; SWD / reset pads

g.desc: 8 MHz HSE with load capacitors; BOOT0 button and pull-down; SWD / reset pads

g.text: DPS368 address 0x76: SDO low; CSB high selects I2C; local SCL / SDA pull-ups

g.desc: DPS368 address 0x76: SDO low; CSB high selects I2C; local SCL / SDA pull-ups

g.text: ADC divider filters | VX_SENSE -> U1.9; 5V_SENSE -> U1.10

g.desc: ADC divider filters | VX_SENSE -> U1.9; 5V_SENSE -> U1.10

g.text: TPS70933: EN pin 3 intentionally floating, supported by internal pull-up

g.desc: TPS70933: EN pin 3 intentionally floating, supported by internal pull-up

g.text: EN and NC are intentionally unconnected. Do not tie EN to VSYS.

g.desc: EN and NC are intentionally unconnected. Do not tie EN to VSYS.

g.text: Buck-priority power mux | 5V_BUCK preferred, USB VBUS fallback

g.desc: Buck-priority power mux | 5V_BUCK preferred, USB VBUS fallback

g.desc: Diode-OR supply -> TPS629210 -> MCU rail; fused DSM supply branch
